clock.causal_entry: Signal bar closes at t+1h; one full guard hour follows; entry is USD-M open t+2h; exit is entry+H.
clock.join: Normalize native units to integer milliseconds and join exact UTC open timestamps; never join by row number or nearest timestamp.

distinctness.matched_comparator: Identical USD-M lifecycle ranked by prior standardized own-USD-M return.
distinctness.reverse_diagnostic: Contemporaneous USD-M innovation ranked against later Spot return; diagnostic only.

economics.funding: For each leg, signed public funding at entry_time <= funding_time < exit_time using the mark-price bar containing funding_time. Each event must be within 60 seconds after a UTC hour; adjacent and boundary coverage must match the row funding_interval_hours within 60 seconds.
economics.leverage_claim: ECONOMIC_1X_PROXY_ONLY; marked gross is measured and must remain <=1000
economics.market_neutrality: ZERO_NET_NOTIONAL_PROXY; beta and factor neutrality are unproven
economics.sleeves: H staggered hourly sleeves, each entry gross 960/H; close matured sleeve before replacing it; initial aggregate entry gross is 960 and initial cash is 40. Marked gross drift is measured and gated at 1000.

provenance.checksum: Publisher .CHECKSUM SHA-256 required for every ZIP.

signal.fit: At each hour, rolling OLS Spot_return = alpha + beta*USD-M_return on the prior 672 complete common hours, excluding the signal hour.
signal.predictor: Current Spot return minus fitted alpha and beta times current USD-M return, divided by prior residual standard deviation.
signal.ranking: Long highest K and short lowest K predictor values; deterministic symbol tie-break.

bootstrap.method: Common-seeded circular block bootstrap over synchronous UTC days including cash days.

statistics.drawdown: Peak-to-trough hourly marked scenario equity including entry/exit costs and funding.
statistics.holm: One-sided centered block-bootstrap p-values adjusted together across 12 absolute-stress and 12 matched-excess hypotheses.

pbo.method: Complete CSCV over four of eight development calendar-month blocks.

statistics.white_reality_check: Common-seeded centered maximum-mean block bootstrap across 12 matched-excess series.

trials.champion_selection: Maximum development stress total; lexicographically lowest trial_id breaks an exact tie; no fallback if that champion fails any gate.

universe.missing_policy: No substitutions. A sleeve stays cash unless all eight fixed names are eligible; a missing required post-entry mark is UNMEASURED.
universe.selection: Fixed before archive outcome access; no outcome or current-volume ranking.
